zh: 两个条件都只和 |x|、|y| 有关，可以先取绝对值；再设 a≤b，看看 |x−y| 与 |x+y| 分别会变成什么。
取绝对值后，|x−y| 与 |x+y| 中较小的是 b−a、较大的是 b+a。第二个不等式 b+a≥b 恒成立，第一个不等式 b−a≤a 等价于 b≤2a，所以只需统计满足“较大者不超过较小者两倍”的下标对。
把所有数取绝对值后排序；用双指针，右端 right 逐个增加，当 a[right]>2×a[left] 时左端右移；此时 [left,right) 中每个元素都能与 right 配对，答案加上 right−left。答案最大约 2×10^10，用 64 位整数。
en: Both conditions depend only on |x| and |y|, so take absolute values first. Then assume a<=b and see what |x-y| and |x+y| turn into.

After taking absolute values, the smaller of |x-y| and |x+y| is b-a and the larger is b+a. The second inequality b+a>=b always holds, and the first one b-a<=a is equivalent to b<=2a. So you only need to count index pairs where the larger value is at most twice the smaller one.

Take absolute values of all numbers and sort them. Use two pointers: advance right one step at a time, and move left forward while a[right] > 2*a[left]. Every element in [left,right) then pairs with right, so add right-left to the answer. The answer can reach about 2*10^10, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Take absolute values and sort. With a<=b, the two inequalities become b-a<=a and b+a>=b, so only b<=2a is needed; count the index pairs in the window with two pointers.

## Proof of correctness

The smaller of the absolute sum and difference is b-a, and the larger is b+a. The second inequality is always true, and the first is equivalent to b<=2a. Sorting does not change the number of index pairs; for each right end the valid left ends form a contiguous suffix, and after sliding the left end, adding the window length counts each pair exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n); the answer is at most 19999900000 and needs 64 bits.
